overview_description.description:
Heard of composable banking? The concept originated here at Mambu. We’ve been champions of composable for over a decade.
Mambu is the only true SaaS cloud core banking platform. Our unique and sustainable composable approach means that independent engines, systems and connectors can be assembled in any configuration to meet business requirements and the ever-changing demands of your customers. 200+ banks, lenders, fintechs, and even retailers in 60 countries turn to us to help them build modern digital financial products faster, securely and cost-effectively.

about_short_description.short_description: Mambu is the only true SaaS cloud core banking platform.

product.name: Mambu Core Banking Platform
product.description: A cloud-native, composable SaaS core banking platform for configuring, launching, and managing deposits, lending, payments, and other financial products through APIs.

product.name: Mambu Lending
product.description: A configurable lending platform for consumer, business, mortgage, embedded, and purchase-finance products, supporting loan origination, servicing, repayments, arrears, and portfolio management.

product.name: Mambu Deposits
product.description: A cloud-native deposits platform for current accounts, savings, term deposits, wallets, and stored-value products, with configurable rules, automated servicing, and real-time transaction support.

product.name: Mambu Payments
product.description: A payments platform combining payment orchestration, processing, reconciliation, bank and scheme connectivity, and a universal gateway through APIs and a centralized control layer.

product.name: Mambu Cloud Services
product.description: Fully managed cloud infrastructure for running regulated financial services, including true SaaS delivery, multi-cloud deployment, automated scaling, backups, redundancy, and platform updates.

product.name: Mambu Banking as a Service
product.description: A managed SaaS foundation for launching partner-led banking products, including wallets, deposits, lending, payments, and embedded financial services.
